comparison.objective: Clamp and saw a wooden strip to length; candidate transfers an uncaged LM block onto a service jig.
comparison.physical_skill: Record turns a vise and performs controlled sawing to a cut line. Candidate aligns two precision profiles and slides a bearing block while maintaining ball containment.
comparison.success_condition: Record requires two physical wood pieces, 150 ± 1 mm retained length, adequate clamping and saw clearance. Candidate requires full transfer and retention of every rolling element without support discontinuity or damage.
comparison.reason: Clamping and material removal are unrelated to bearing-block support transfer.
